title.en: Scope and classification of chemical industries

h.en: Scope and classification of chemical industries

body.en:
Definition

A chemical industry converts raw materials into useful substances through chemical reactions supported by physical operations such as mixing, separation and heat transfer. Chemical process technology connects the chemistry with plant equipment, material recovery, product quality and safe waste handling.

Classification

By product chemistry:inorganic industries include acids, alkalis, cement and lime; organic industries include petrochemicals, dyes, soaps and many polymers. By scale/value:bulk or heavy chemicals are large-volume base materials; fine/speciality chemicals are selected for purity or performance. By feedstock:mineral-based, coal-based, petroleum/gas-based and renewable/bio-based industries. These are overlapping classification bases, not mutually exclusive lists.

Scope and flowsheet reading

The plant sequence is raw-material preparation → reaction/conversion → separation and purification → finishing/storage. Utilities, heat recovery, recycle and effluent treatment support that sequence. A PFD identifies equipment and material routes; it is not a construction drawing or a P&ID. In the new drawings, E identifies equipment, F a feed, P an outlet, L an auxiliary connection and R a recycle. Follow arrow direction, not merely left-to-right order.

વ્યાખ્યા

રાસાયણિક અભિક્રિયા તથા mixing, separation અને heat transfer જેવી ભૌતિક પ્રક્રિયાઓથી કાચા માલને ઉપયોગી પદાર્થોમાં ફેરવતો ઉદ્યોગ એટલે chemical industry. Chemical process technologyમાં chemistry સાથે plant equipment, material recovery, product quality તથા સુરક્ષિત waste treatmentનો અભ્યાસ થાય છે.

વર્ગીકરણ

Product chemistry મુજબ inorganic ઉદ્યોગોમાં acids, alkalis, cement અને lime; organic ઉદ્યોગોમાં petrochemicals, dyes, soaps તથા ઘણાં polymers આવે છે. Scale/value મુજબ bulk/heavy chemicals મોટા જથ્થાનાં મૂળભૂત chemicals છે; fine/speciality chemicalsમાં purity અથવા performance મહત્વની છે. Feedstock મુજબ mineral, coal, petroleum/gas તથા renewable/bio-based ઉદ્યોગો થાય છે. આ અલગ classification bases છે; એક ઉદ્યોગ એકથી વધુ વર્ગમાં આવી શકે.

કાર્યક્ષેત્ર તથા Flowsheet વાંચન

Plantમાં raw-material preparation → reaction/conversion → separation/purification → finishing/storageનો ક્રમ હોય છે. Utilities, heat recovery, recycle તથા effluent treatment તેને મદદ કરે છે. PFD equipment અને material route બતાવે છે; તે construction drawing કે P&ID નથી. નવા drawingsમાં E equipment, F feed, P outlet, L auxiliary connection અને R recycle છે. ફક્ત ડાબેથી જમણે નહીં,arrowની દિશા પ્રમાણે વાંચવું.

Definition

H2SO4 is a strong diprotic mineral acid; commercial concentrated acid is commonly about98% by mass.

Physical properties

Pure/concentrated material is a colourless to slightly coloured, dense, viscous liquid. About98% acid has density near1.84g/cm³ at room temperature; density and boiling/freezing behaviour depend on concentration. It is hygroscopic and mixes with water with large heat evolution. It is not correct to give one boiling point for every aqueous concentration.

Chemical behaviour and handling

It neutralises bases to sulphates; hot concentrated acid can act as an oxidising/dehydrating agent. Dilution and corrosion behaviour are concentration-dependent. Use institution-approved dilution practice:acid is introduced into water under cooling, never water into a bulk of concentrated acid.

Uses

Fertiliser manufacture, phosphoric acid, pickling, detergent/dye intermediates, petroleum processing and lead–acid battery electrolyte of specified concentration.

વ્યાખ્યા

H2SO4 મજબૂત diprotic mineral acid છે; સામાન્ય commercial concentrated acid આશરે98 mass% હોય છે.

ભૌતિક ગુણધર્મો

શુદ્ધ/concentrated પદાર્થ રંગહીનથી થોડો રંગવાળો,ભારે તથા ચીકણો પ્રવાહી છે. Room temperatureએ આશરે98% acidની density લગભગ1.84g/cm³ હોય છે; density તથા boiling/freezing વર્તન concentration પ્રમાણે બદલાય છે. તે hygroscopic છે અને પાણી સાથે ભળતાં ઘણો ઉષ્મા છોડે છે. દરેક aqueous concentration માટે એક જ boiling point આપવો યોગ્ય નથી.

રાસાયણિક વર્તન તથા Handling

Bases સાથે sulphates બનાવે છે; ગરમ concentrated acid oxidising/dehydrating agent તરીકે કાર્ય કરી શકે છે. Dilution તથા corrosion concentration પર આધારિત છે. Approved dilutionમાં cooling સાથે acidને પાણીમાં ઉમેરાય છે; concentrated acidના મોટા જથ્થામાં પાણી રેડાતું નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Fertilisers, phosphoric acid, pickling, detergent/dye intermediates, petroleum processing તથા નિર્ધારિત concentrationવાળા lead–acid battery electrolyteમાં ઉપયોગ.

Definition

Hydrochloric acid is the aqueous solution of hydrogen chloride, HCl; dry HCl itself is a gas.

Physical properties

It is a colourless, pungent liquid; strong commercial acid fumes in moist air. HCl is highly soluble in water and its dissolution releases heat. Density varies with strength; roughly35–37% acid is about1.18–1.19g/cm³ near room temperature. Aqueous acid is volatile and must be stored in compatible closed equipment with controlled venting.

Chemical behaviour and handling

It is a strong monoprotic acid, forming chlorides with bases and many metals. Unlike hot concentrated H2SO4,it is normally treated as a non-oxidising acid. Chloride corrosion and acid mist require suitable materials and ventilation.

Uses

Steel pickling, pH control, chloride salts, resin regeneration and chemical/pharmaceutical processing where the specified grade permits.

ભૌતિક ગુણધર્મો

તે રંગહીન,તીવ્ર ગંધવાળો પ્રવાહી છે; strong commercial acid ભેજવાળી હવામાં fumes આપે છે. HCl પાણીમાં ખૂબ દ્રાવ્ય છે અને dissolutionમાં ઉષ્મા છૂટે છે. Strength પ્રમાણે density બદલાય છે; આશરે35–37% acidની density room temperature નજીક1.18–1.19g/cm³ છે. Aqueous acid volatile હોવાથી compatible closed equipment તથા controlled venting જરૂરી છે.

રાસાયણિક વર્તન તથા Handling

તે strong monoprotic acid છે; bases તથા અનેક metals સાથે chlorides બનાવે છે. Hot concentrated H2SO4થી વિપરીત,સામાન્ય રીતે non-oxidising acid ગણાય છે. Chloride corrosion તથા acid mist માટે યોગ્ય materials અને ventilation જોઈએ.

ઉપયોગો

Steel pickling, pH control, chloride salts, resin regeneration તથા નિર્ધારિત grade મુજબ chemical/pharmaceutical processingમાં ઉપયોગ.

Definition

Soda ash is anhydrous sodium carbonate, Na2CO3;washing soda is its decahydrate, Na2CO3·10H2O.

Physical properties

It is a white, nonvolatile crystalline/powdery solid, soluble in water. Light and dense soda ash have the same main chemistry but different bulk densities and handling properties. Anhydrous material melts near851°C; hydrate water changes storage and analysis behaviour.

Chemical behaviour and handling

Aqueous solution is alkaline due to carbonate hydrolysis. Acids release CO2;Ca²⁺ can be precipitated as CaCO3 in water softening. Soda ash is less strongly caustic than NaOH and is not a substitute for it in every process.

Uses

Glass manufacture, detergent builders, water softening, sodium salts, pulp/paper and alkalinity adjustment.

વ્યાખ્યા

Anhydrous sodium carbonate, Na2CO3 એટલે soda ash; washing soda તેનું decahydrate Na2CO3·10H2O છે.

ભૌતિક ગુણધર્મો

તે સફેદ,nonvolatile crystalline/powdery solid છે અને પાણીમાં દ્રાવ્ય છે. Light તથા dense soda ashની મુખ્ય chemistry એકસરખી છે,પરંતુ bulk density તથા handling ગુણધર્મો અલગ હોય છે. Anhydrous પદાર્થ લગભગ851°Cએ પીગળે છે; hydrateમાં પાણી હોવાથી storage તથા analysis વર્તન બદલાય છે.

રાસાયણિક વર્તન તથા Handling

Carbonate hydrolysisને લીધે aqueous solution alkaline છે. Acid સાથે CO2 છૂટે છે; water softeningમાં Ca²⁺ને CaCO3 તરીકે precipitate કરી શકાય છે. Soda ash, NaOH કરતાં ઓછી caustic છે અને દરેક processમાં તેનો વિકલ્પ નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Glass manufacture, detergent builders, water softening, sodium salts, pulp/paper તથા alkalinity adjustmentમાં ઉપયોગ.

Definition

Caustic soda is sodium hydroxide, NaOH, a strong alkali supplied as solutions, flakes or pellets.

Physical properties

Pure NaOH is a white solid, melting near318°C. It is highly hygroscopic/deliquescent and very soluble in water with strong heat evolution. Solution density and boiling point depend on concentration; flakes absorb moisture and CO2 during poor storage.

Chemical behaviour and handling

It neutralises acids, saponifies triglycerides and absorbs CO2 to form carbonate. Aluminium and certain other materials can react with strong alkali, with hydrogen evolution; compatible materials are essential.

Uses

Soap, pulp/paper, alumina processing, textile mercerisation, petroleum refining, water treatment and chemical manufacture.

વ્યાખ્યા

Sodium hydroxide, NaOH એટલે caustic soda; આ strong alkali solutions, flakes અથવા pellets રૂપે મળે છે.

ભૌતિક ગુણધર્મો

શુદ્ધ NaOH સફેદ solid છે અને લગભગ318°Cએ પીગળે છે. તે ખૂબ hygroscopic/deliquescent છે અને પાણીમાં ઓગળતાં ઘણો ઉષ્મા છોડે છે. Solutionની density તથા boiling point concentration પર આધારિત છે; અયોગ્ય storageમાં flakes ભેજ અને CO2 શોષે છે.

રાસાયણિક વર્તન તથા Handling

Acidsને neutralise કરે છે,triglyceridesનું saponification કરે છે અને CO2 શોષીને carbonate બનાવે છે. Aluminium તથા કેટલાક materials strong alkali સાથે react કરી hydrogen છોડે છે; તેથી compatible materials જરૂરી છે.

ઉપયોગો

Soap, pulp/paper, alumina processing, textile mercerisation, petroleum refining, water treatment તથા chemical manufactureમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition

DCDA means double contact, double absorption:a sulphuric-acid process in which catalytic SO2 oxidation is interrupted by SO3 absorption and followed by further oxidation and a final absorption.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Clean molten sulphur, dry air, supported vanadium-pentoxide catalyst, strong circulating acid and controlled water make-up. The drawing selects a3+1bed arrangement; DCDA plants may use other bed groupings.

S + O2 → SO2; 2SO2 + O2 ⇌ 2SO3 (exothermic, catalytic); SO3 + H2O → H2SO4 (overall absorption chemistry).

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Air drying and sulphur burning—E01–E04

The blower supplies air through the acid drying tower, where moisture is removed by a separate strong-acid circuit. Dry air reaches the refractory-lined sulphur burner and supports oxidation of filtered molten sulphur to SO2. The hot gas enters the waste-heat boiler, which recovers sensible heat as steam and conditions the gas for catalytic conversion. Drying limits downstream acid condensation and corrosion.

2. First conversion and intermediate absorption—E05–E07

Gas passes successively over converter beds1–3 with inter-bed heat exchange, shown as a grouped converter. The reaction is reversible and exothermic:cooling between beds improves equilibrium while the catalyst provides an adequate rate. After suitable cooling, gas enters the packed intermediate absorber. Circulating acid removes much of the SO3;unconverted SO2 and oxygen continue as gas. This intermediate removal is the defining difference from ordinary single-absorption contact operation.

3. Reheating, final conversion and absorption—E08–E12

Intermediate-absorber exit gas is too cool for the final catalyst bed, so a heat exchanger reheats it. Bed4 converts additional SO2 after the earlier SO3 removal has shifted the reaction opportunity. The gas is cooled again and enters the final absorber. A mist eliminator captures entrained acid droplets before controlled stack discharge. Conversion, absorption and mist removal perform different duties and must not be treated as one separator.

4. Acid circulation and product withdrawal—E13–E15

Acid leaving both absorbers returns to the circulation tank, passes through an acid cooler and is redistributed over tower packing. Controlled water make-up and product withdrawal maintain strong-acid concentration and inventory; the dryer circuit is separately indicated. SO3 is not absorbed directly in a large water tank, because the intense heat produces difficult acid mist. Industrial absorption commonly uses acid near98–99%,with the exact strength controlled for the chosen plant.

Operating and engineering considerations

Typical catalyst inlet temperatures are in the approximate400–450°C range, not one identical temperature in every bed. Avoid catalyst poisons, dust, acid-dew-point corrosion, hot spots and mist emissions. The supplied page1is conventional contact/oleum equipment, not a DCDA intermediate-absorption arrangement; this syllabus-specific drawing is therefore used.

Applications / uses

Acid is used for fertilisers, phosphoric acid, metal treatment, chemical intermediates and battery acid after appropriate dilution/grade control.

વ્યાખ્યા

DCDA એટલે double contact, double absorption. તેમાં catalytic SO2 oxidationના બે conversion groups વચ્ચે SO3 શોષાય છે; ત્યારબાદ વધુ oxidation અને final absorption થાય છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

શુદ્ધ molten sulphur, dry air, supported vanadium-pentoxide catalyst, strong circulating acid તથા controlled water make-up લેવાય છે. Drawingમાં3+1 bed arrangement પસંદ છે; બીજા bed groupings પણ શક્ય છે.

S + O2 → SO2; 2SO2 + O2 ⇌ 2SO3 (exothermic, catalytic); SO3 + H2O → H2SO4 (overall absorption chemistry).

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Air drying તથા Sulphur burning—E01–E04

Blowerની air acid drying towerમાંથી પસાર થાય છે; separate strong-acid circuit તેનો ભેજ દૂર કરે છે. Dry air refractory-lined sulphur burnerમાં filtered molten sulphurને SO2માં oxidise કરે છે. Hot gas waste-heat boilerમાં જાય છે,જ્યાં sensible heatથી steam બને છે તથા gas catalytic conversion માટે યોગ્ય થાય છે. Dryingથી downstream acid condensation અને corrosion ઓછાં થાય છે.

2. First conversion તથા Intermediate absorption—E05–E07

Gas grouped converterના beds1–3માંથી inter-bed heat exchange સાથે પસાર થાય છે. Reaction reversible તથા exothermic હોવાથી beds વચ્ચે coolingથી equilibrium લાભ મળે છે અને catalyst પૂરતો rate આપે છે. યોગ્ય cooling પછી gas packed intermediate absorberમાં જાય છે. Circulating acid મોટો SO3 ભાગ શોષે છે; unconverted SO2 તથા oxygen gasરૂપે આગળ જાય છે. આ મધ્યવર્તી SO3 removal, ordinary single-absorption contact operationથી મુખ્ય ભેદ છે.

3. Reheating, final conversion તથા Absorption—E08–E12

Intermediate absorberની exit gas final catalyst માટે ઠંડી હોવાથી exchangerથી reheat થાય છે. પહેલાના SO3 removal પછી bed4માં વધુ SO2નું conversion થાય છે. Gas ફરી cool થઈ final absorberમાં જાય છે. Mist eliminator entrained acid droplets પકડીને gasને controlled stack તરફ મોકલે છે. Conversion, absorption તથા mist removalનાં કાર્યો જુદાં છે; તેમને એક separator ગણવો નહીં.

4. Acid circulation તથા Product withdrawal—E13–E15

બંને absorbersનું acid circulation tankમાં આવે છે; acid cooler પછી tower packing પર ફરી વહેંચાય છે. Controlled water make-up તથા product withdrawalથી strong-acid concentration અને inventory જળવાય છે; dryer circuit અલગ બતાવ્યો છે. SO3ને મોટા water tankમાં સીધું absorb કરતા નથી,કારણ કે તીવ્ર heatથી મુશ્કેલ acid mist બને છે. Industrial absorption સામાન્ય રીતે આશરે98–99% acidમાં થાય છે; ચોક્કસ strength plant પ્રમાણે નિયંત્રિત થાય છે.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Catalyst inlet સામાન્ય રીતે આશરે400–450°C rangeમાં હોય છે; દરેક bedનું એકસરખું temperature નથી. Catalyst poisons, dust, acid-dew-point corrosion, hot spots તથા mist emissions રોકવા જોઈએ. તમારી PDFનું પાનું1 conventional contact/oleum equipment બતાવે છે; તે DCDA intermediate absorption નથી. તેથી અહીં syllabus-specific drawing વાપર્યું છે.

ઉપયોગો

Fertilisers, phosphoric acid, metal treatment, chemical intermediates તથા યોગ્ય dilution/grade પછી battery acidમાં ઉપયોગ થાય છે.

body.en:
Definition

Hydrogen chloride is made by direct combination of hydrogen and chlorine; absorption of the resulting gas in water produces hydrochloric acid.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Clean hydrogen, dry chlorine and demineralised absorption water. The gas-handling system is enclosed and interlocked; the chemistry below is an industrial overview, not a gas-mixing experiment.

H2 + Cl2 → 2HCl; HCl(g) + H2O → H3O+ + Cl− (aqueous).

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Gas preparation and synthesis—E01–E02

Hydrogen is purified before the controlled feed system. Hydrogen and chlorine enter a purpose-designed synthesis burner through separate controlled inlets and react exothermically to form HCl gas. The burner, gas lines and protective systems prevent uncontrolled premixing and flashback. Industrial control may maintain a small hydrogen excess to limit free chlorine in the acid; this is not an instruction to manually mix the gases.

2. Cooling and water absorption—E03–E04

The hot synthesis gas is cooled in corrosion-resistant equipment and passed to a packed or falling-film absorber. Gas and absorption water contact over a large wetted area, so HCl dissolves rapidly. Both gas cooling and heat removal from dissolution are needed; without cooling, the liquid temperature rises and absorption becomes poorer. Water rate and acid circulation control the product strength.

3. Mist control and product handling—E05–E06

The acid product leaves the absorber for cooling and compatible storage. Remaining gas passes through an acid-mist separator and a tail-gas scrubber, which recover residual HCl before a controlled outlet. Scrubber liquid requires monitored reuse or treatment; the tail-gas system is not a route for releasing untreated chlorine or HCl.

Operating and engineering considerations

Important controls are feed-gas purity, automatic gas-ratio control, burner protection, heat removal, acid strength and residual chlorine. The absorber and storage must tolerate wet-HCl corrosion; dry and wet services do not necessarily use the same material.

Applications / uses

Steel pickling, chloride salts, resin regeneration, pH control and chemical processing.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Hydrogen અને chlorineના direct combinationથી hydrogen chloride gas બને છે; તેને પાણીમાં absorb કરવાથી hydrochloric acid મળે છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Clean hydrogen, dry chlorine તથા demineralised absorption water લેવાય છે. Gas-handling system enclosed તથા interlocked હોય છે; આ industrial overview છે,gas-mixing experiment નથી.

H2 + Cl2 → 2HCl; HCl(g) + H2O → H3O+ + Cl− (aqueous).

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Gas preparation તથા Synthesis—E01–E02

Hydrogen controlled feed પહેલાં purified થાય છે. Hydrogen અને chlorine purpose-designed synthesis burnerના separate controlled inletsથી પ્રવેશે છે અને exothermic reactionથી HCl gas બને છે. Burner, gas lines તથા protective systems uncontrolled premixing અને flashback રોકે છે. Acidમાં free chlorine ઘટાડવા industrial control થોડો hydrogen excess રાખી શકે છે; આ gasesને જાતે mix કરવાની સૂચના નથી.

2. Cooling તથા Water absorption—E03–E04

Hot synthesis gas corrosion-resistant equipmentમાં cool થઈ packed અથવા falling-film absorberમાં જાય છે. Gas તથા water મોટા wetted area પર સંપર્કમાં આવતા HCl ઝડપથી ઓગળે છે. Gas cooling ઉપરાંત dissolutionની heat પણ દૂર કરવી પડે છે; cooling વગર liquidનું temperature વધે અને absorption ઘટે. Water rate તથા acid circulationથી product strength નિયંત્રિત થાય છે.

3. Mist control તથા Product handling—E05–E06

Acid product absorberમાંથી cooling તથા compatible storageમાં જાય છે. Remaining gas acid-mist separator અને tail-gas scrubberમાંથી પસાર થાય છે; residual HCl recover થયા પછી controlled outlet મળે છે. Scrubber liquidનું monitored reuse અથવા treatment જરૂરી છે; untreated chlorine/HCl છોડવા tail-gas system વપરાતો નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Feed-gas purity, automatic gas-ratio control, burner protection, heat removal, acid strength તથા residual chlorine મહત્વના controls છે. Absorber/storage wet-HCl corrosion સહન કરી શકે તેવા હોવા જોઈએ; dry તથા wet service માટે એક જ material જરૂરી નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Steel pickling, chloride salts, resin regeneration, pH control તથા chemical processingમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition

The Solvay process manufactures soda ash by precipitating sodium bicarbonate from ammoniated brine and calcining it; ammonia is regenerated from the mother liquor.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Sodium-chloride brine, limestone, coke/fuel, water and make-up ammonia. Ammonia is largely recycled rather than consumed in the overall reaction.

NaCl + NH3 + CO2 + H2O → NaHCO3↓ + NH4Cl; 2NaHCO3 → Na2CO3 + CO2 + H2O; CaCO3 → CaO + CO2; CaO + H2O → Ca(OH)2; 2NH4Cl + Ca(OH)2 → 2NH3 + CaCl2 + 2H2O. Overall:2NaCl + CaCO3 → Na2CO3 + CaCl2.

Primary flowsheet—your supplied PDF, page 2

How to read the supplied drawing

Follow ammoniation tower → cooled carbonating tower → rotary filter press → calciner → water cooler for the solid product. Trace the separate free- and combined-ammonia stills, slaker, lime kiln, NH3–H2O condenser and recycle lines for chemical recovery.

1. Brine ammoniation and carbonation

Calcium and magnesium impurities are removed from brine before it is pumped into the ammoniation tower. Recycled and make-up ammonia dissolve in the brine; cooling removes the heat of absorption. Ammoniated brine enters the cooled carbonating tower and contacts CO2 supplied from the lime kiln and bicarbonate calciner. Sodium bicarbonate, which is relatively sparingly soluble in this concentrated system, crystallises while ammonium chloride remains mainly in the liquor.

2. Filtration, calcination and cooling

The rotary filter press shown in the PDF separates bicarbonate crystals from mother liquor. Washing limits chloride carry-over into soda ash. The calciner decomposes the filtered bicarbonate to sodium carbonate, CO2 and water vapour. Gas cooling/condensation permits CO2 recovery; the water-cooled soda-ash cooler lowers product temperature before handling. The solid product is not obtained simply by evaporating the entire ammonium-chloride mother liquor.

3. Lime kiln and ammonia regeneration

Limestone and coke enter the lime kiln with combustion air. Calcination supplies CO2 and quicklime. The slaker reacts quicklime with water to form milk of lime. In the supplied drawing, the free-ammonia still first releases recoverable free ammonia; the combined-ammonia still receives milk of lime to liberate ammonia from ammonium salts. CaCl2-rich liquor and impurities leave this recovery section for controlled management.

4. Condenser and recycle connections

The NH3–H2O condenser, coolers and gas-moving equipment in the reference recover ammonia-containing vapour and condition recycled gases. Recovered ammonia returns to the ammoniation tower; kiln and calciner CO2 return to carbonation. These closed recovery routes reduce fresh-ammonia demand and raw-material loss. The new study redraw groups the two ammonia stills as one recovery still; the original PDF retains the separate equipment used in this explanation.

Simplified study redraw—equipment IDs are for this redraw only

Operating and engineering considerations

Control brine purity, carbonation cooling, bicarbonate crystal size, filter washing, calciner heat supply and ammonia losses. CaCl2 discharge, salt loading, dust and fuel/CO2 emissions require treatment or permitted recovery; recycle does not eliminate all waste.

Applications / uses

Glass, detergents, water softening, sodium salts and general alkaline processing.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Sodium-chloride brine, limestone, coke/fuel, water તથા make-up ammonia લેવાય છે. Overall reactionમાં ammonia મુખ્યત્વે recycle થાય છે,net reactant તરીકે ખર્ચાતું નથી.

મૂળ drawing કેવી રીતે સમજવી

Calciner filtered bicarbonateને sodium carbonate, CO2 તથા water vapourમાં ફેરવે છે. Gas cooling/condensation પછી CO2 recover થાય છે; water-cooled soda-ash cooler productનું temperature ઘટાડે છે. આખા ammonium-chloride mother liquorને evaporate કરીને soda ash મળતું નથી.

3. Lime kiln તથા Ammonia regeneration

Lime kilnમાં limestone તથા coke સાથે combustion air જાય છે. Calcinationથી CO2 તથા quicklime મળે છે. Slakerમાં quicklime અને waterથી milk of lime બને છે. મૂળ drawingમાં free-ammonia still પહેલેથી ઉપલબ્ધ free ammonia બહાર કાઢે છે; combined-ammonia stillમાં milk of lime, ammonium saltsમાંથી ammonia મુક્ત કરે છે. CaCl2-rich liquor તથા impurities recovery sectionમાંથી controlled management માટે બહાર જાય છે.

4. Condenser તથા Recycle connections

Referenceના NH3–H2O condenser, coolers તથા gas-moving equipment ammonia-containing vapour recover કરીને recycle gasesને condition કરે છે. Recovered ammonia ammoniation towerમાં તથા kiln/calciner CO2 carbonationમાં પાછાં જાય છે. આ recoveryથી fresh-ammonia demand અને raw-material loss ઘટે છે. નવા simplified redrawમાં બે ammonia stillsને એક recovery stillમાં group કર્યાં છે; અહીંની સમજણ માટે મૂળ PDFના અલગ equipment જ ધ્યાનમાં લેવા.

Simplified study redraw—E numbers ફક્ત આ redraw માટે છે

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Brine purity, carbonation cooling, bicarbonate crystal size, filter washing, calciner heat supply તથા ammonia losses નિયંત્રિત કરવા. CaCl2 discharge, salt loading, dust તથા fuel/CO2 emissions માટે treatment અથવા permitted recovery જરૂરી છે; recycleથી બધા waste દૂર થતા નથી.

ઉપયોગો

Glass, detergents, water softening, sodium salts તથા alkaline processingમાં ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Definition

Electrolytic chlor-alkali manufacture decomposes purified brine into chlorine, hydrogen and sodium hydroxide; the selected modern route uses an ion-selective membrane.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Highly purified sodium-chloride brine, deionised water and direct-current electrical energy. The membrane separates anode and cathode compartments; it is not a porous diaphragm.

Anode:2Cl− → Cl2 + 2e−; cathode:2H2O + 2e− → H2 + 2OH−. Overall:2NaCl + 2H2O → 2NaOH + Cl2 + H2.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Brine treatment and cell construction—E01–E03

Primary treatment precipitates hardness impurities and removes solids; secondary polishing lowers residual calcium/magnesium to the membrane specification. The electrolyser has an anode brine chamber, a cathode water/caustic chamber and a cation-exchange membrane between them. Na+ migrates through the membrane while most chloride ions and bulk mixing are restricted. Separate gas headers prevent chlorine and hydrogen from mixing.

2. Electrode reactions and caustic finishing—E03–E06

DC current oxidises chloride at the anode to chlorine. At the cathode, water is reduced to hydrogen and OH−;Na+ arriving through the membrane supplies electrical balance and forms the caustic solution. The catholyte passes to a gas/liquid separator to remove hydrogen. Membrane-cell caustic, commonly about30–35% depending on design, is concentrated by evaporation when a stronger product is required, then sent to compatible storage.

3. Chlorine, hydrogen and brine recovery—E07–E12

Wet chlorine is separated from entrained liquid, cooled, dried and compressed/refrigerated as required for its intended supply form. Hydrogen is separately purified or used as a controlled fuel/feedstock. Depleted anolyte is dechlorinated and resaturated with salt before returning through brine treatment. These are three distinct recovery paths; chlorine is not routed into the hydrogen separator or mixed with caustic product.

Operating and engineering considerations

Key issues are electricity demand, membrane fouling, brine purity, chlorine leakage and hydrogen/chlorine segregation. The owner PDF page3shows diaphragm and mercury routes; their exact flows are explained separately below, not relabelled as membrane operation.

Applications / uses

NaOH:soap, pulp/paper, textiles, alumina and neutralisation. Chlorine:chemical synthesis and controlled disinfection systems. Hydrogen:chemical synthesis or compatible fuel use.

વ્યાખ્યા

Purified brineના electrolysisથી chlorine, hydrogen તથા sodium hydroxide બનાવવાનું chlor-alkali manufacture છે; અહીં modern ion-selective membrane route પસંદ છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Highly purified sodium-chloride brine, deionised water તથા DC electrical energy લેવાય છે. Membrane anode/cathode compartmentsને જુદાં રાખે છે; તે porous diaphragm નથી.

Anode:2Cl− → Cl2 + 2e−; cathode:2H2O + 2e− → H2 + 2OH−. Overall:2NaCl + 2H2O → 2NaOH + Cl2 + H2.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Brine treatment તથા Cell construction—E01–E03

Primary treatment hardness impuritiesને precipitate કરીને solids દૂર કરે છે; secondary polishing residual Ca/Mgને membrane specification સુધી ઘટાડે છે. Electrolyserમાં anode brine chamber, cathode water/caustic chamber તથા વચ્ચે cation-exchange membrane હોય છે. Na+ membraneમાંથી જાય છે,જ્યારે મોટા ભાગના chloride ions તથા bulk mixing રોકાય છે. Separate gas headers chlorine અને hydrogenને ભળતાં રોકે છે.

2. Electrode reactions તથા Caustic finishing—E03–E06

DC currentથી anode પર chlorideનું oxidation થઈ chlorine બને છે. Cathode પર waterનું reduction થઈ hydrogen તથા OH− મળે છે; membraneથી આવેલ Na+ electrical balance આપીને caustic solution બનાવે છે. Catholyte gas/liquid separatorમાં hydrogen છોડે છે. Design મુજબ સામાન્ય રીતે આશરે30–35% membrane-cell causticને વધુ strength જોઈએ ત્યારે evaporate કરીને compatible storageમાં મોકલાય છે.

3. Chlorine, hydrogen તથા Brine recovery—E07–E12

Wet chlorineમાંથી entrained liquid દૂર કરી તેને cool, dry તથા supply form મુજબ compress/refrigerate કરાય છે. Hydrogen અલગથી purify થાય છે અથવા controlled fuel/feedstock તરીકે વપરાય છે. Depleted anolyte dechlorinate થઈ saltથી resaturate થયા પછી brine treatmentમાં પાછું જાય છે. આ ત્રણ recovery paths જુદાં છે; chlorineને hydrogen separatorમાં કે caustic productમાં ભેળવાતું નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Electricity demand, membrane fouling, brine purity, chlorine leakage તથા H2/Cl2 segregation મુખ્ય મુદ્દા છે. Owner PDFના પાના3માં diaphragm તથા mercury routes છે; તેને membrane તરીકે નહીં,નીચે અલગથી મૂળ flow મુજબ સમજાવ્યું છે.

ઉપયોગો

NaOH:soap, pulp/paper, textiles, alumina તથા neutralisation. Chlorine:chemical synthesis તથા controlled disinfection. Hydrogen:chemical synthesis અથવા compatible fuel તરીકે ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Reference and cell distinction

The supplied page3contains two alternative historical routes, not two cells in series. Both use the overall chlor-alkali reaction, but their cathode products and purification requirements differ. The mercury route is retained for understanding the supplied drawing, not recommended as a new environmentally preferable installation.

Diaphragm-route brine and cell

Brine from wells enters the purifier, where soda ash helps remove hardness; sludge is withdrawn. Filtered brine is heated before the diaphragm cell. A porous diaphragm separates electrode spaces while allowing brine flow toward the cathode. Chlorine leaves the anode and hydrogen leaves the cathode; the cathode liquor contains NaOH together with substantial unreacted NaCl.

Evaporators and salt recovery

The diaphragm liquor enters multiple-effect evaporators. As water is removed and caustic concentration rises, salt crystallises and is separated in the centrifuge. The reference labels about50% caustic for further purification/concentration; actual composition is plant-dependent. Recovered salt is returned through the salt saturator/filter circuit rather than sold as caustic.

Mercury cell and denuding tower

Filtered saturated brine passes through the constant-head feed tank into the mercury cell. Sodium is first obtained as sodium amalgam in the flowing mercury cathode; chlorine is evolved separately at the anode. The amalgam goes to the denuding/decomposer tower, where reaction with water yields NaOH and hydrogen and regenerates mercury. Mercury returns to the cell; depleted brine returns for resaturation. The scan’s70% caustic label is a legacy schematic claim, not a universal decomposer concentration; approximately50% is a common commercial mercury-cell caustic strength.

Common chlorine treatment and environmental limits

Wet chlorine from either alternative is cooled, dried with sulphuric acid and cooled/refrigerated for liquid storage as shown. The historical refrigerant/temperature labels in the scan are not present-day design specifications. Mercury loss and contamination are major reasons for replacing mercury technology; old asbestos-containing diaphragms also raise serious health concerns. Modern non-asbestos diaphragms and membrane cells must not be confused with those historical materials.
body.gu:
Reference તથા Cellનો ભેદ

પાના3માં બે historical alternative routes છે; બે cells seriesમાં નથી. Overall chlor-alkali reaction સમાન છે,પરંતુ cathode products તથા purification જુદાં પડે છે. Mercury route ફક્ત મૂળ drawing સમજવા માટે રાખી છે; તેને નવા environmentally preferable plant તરીકે સૂચવેલ નથી.

Diaphragm routeનું Brine તથા Cell

Well brine purifierમાં જાય છે; soda ashથી hardness removal થાય છે અને sludge બહાર કાઢાય છે. Filtered brine ગરમ થઈ diaphragm cellમાં જાય છે. Porous diaphragm electrode spaces જુદાં રાખે છે છતાં brineને cathode તરફ વહેવા દે છે. Anodeથી chlorine તથા cathodeથી hydrogen નીકળે છે; cathode liquorમાં NaOH સાથે ઘણું unreacted NaCl પણ હોય છે.

Evaporators તથા Salt recovery

Diaphragm liquor multiple-effect evaporatorsમાં જાય છે. Water removalથી caustic concentration વધતાં salt crystallise થાય છે અને centrifugeમાં અલગ પડે છે. Referenceમાં આશરે50% caustic આગળ purification/concentration માટે બતાવ્યું છે; actual composition plant પ્રમાણે હોય છે. Recovered salt, salt saturator/filter circuitમાં પાછું જાય છે; તે caustic product નથી.

Mercury cell તથા Denuding tower

Filtered saturated brine constant-head feed tankથી mercury cellમાં જાય છે. Flowing mercury cathodeમાં sodium પહેલા sodium amalgam બને છે; anode પર chlorine અલગ નીકળે છે. Amalgam denuding/decomposer towerમાં water સાથે react કરીને NaOH તથા hydrogen બનાવે છે અને mercury પુનઃ મળે છે. Mercury cellમાં તથા depleted brine resaturationમાં પાછાં જાય છે. Scanનું70% caustic label legacy schematicનું label છે,universal decomposer concentration નથી; commercial mercury-cell caustic માટે આશરે50% સામાન્ય strength છે.

Common Chlorine treatment તથા Environmental મર્યાદા

બંને alternativeમાંથી મળતું wet chlorine drawing મુજબ cool થાય છે,sulphuric acidથી dry થાય છે તથા refrigeration પછી liquid storageમાં જાય છે. Scanનાં historical refrigerant/temperature labelsને આજના design specification માનવાં નહીં. Mercury loss/contaminationને કારણે mercury technology બદલાય છે; જૂના asbestos-containing diaphragms પણ ગંભીર health concern છે. Modern non-asbestos diaphragm તથા membrane cellsને આ historical materials સાથે ગૂંચવવાં નહીં.

body.en:
Gas quality and catalyst performance

Dust and feed impurities can block passages or poison the vanadium catalyst. Provide sulphur filtration, air drying and appropriate gas cleaning. Excessive pressure drop reduces throughput; temperature profiling helps identify poor flow distribution or catalyst deterioration. Conversion requires both suitable catalytic rate and favourable equilibrium, so simply heating every bed more is not a solution.

Heat recovery and corrosion

The burner and converter release large amounts of heat. Waste-heat boilers and inter-bed exchangers recover energy and avoid hot spots. Metal surfaces must not unintentionally fall below the acid dew point in susceptible gas sections. Materials are selected for the actual acid concentration and temperature; strong-acid compatibility cannot be assumed for dilute acid during start-up or water ingress.

Absorption, emissions and control

Poor acid distribution, inadequate cooling or wrong acid strength lowers SO3 absorption and increases mist. Maintain circulation, packing condition, cooler performance and mist elimination. Monitor SO2/SO3 emissions and prevent unsafe water entry. DCDA lowers residual SO2 through additional conversion, but does not remove the need for emission monitoring or safe shutdown systems.
body.gu:
Gas quality તથા Catalyst performance

Dust તથા feed impurities passages block કરી શકે અથવા vanadium catalystને poison કરી શકે છે. Sulphur filtration, air drying તથા યોગ્ય gas cleaning રાખવાં. Excess pressure dropથી throughput ઘટે છે; temperature profilingથી poor distribution/catalyst deterioration શોધાય છે. Conversion માટે catalytic rate અને equilibrium બંને જોઈએ; દરેક bed વધારે ગરમ કરવો ઉપાય નથી.

Heat recovery તથા Corrosion

Burner તથા converterમાં ઘણો ઉષ્મા છૂટે છે. Waste-heat boilers તથા inter-bed exchangers energy recover કરે છે અને hot spots રોકે છે. Susceptible gas sectionsમાં metal surface acid dew pointથી અનિયંત્રિત રીતે નીચે ન જવી જોઈએ. Material actual acid strength/temperature પ્રમાણે પસંદ થાય છે; strong-acid compatibilityને start-upના dilute acid અથવા water ingress માટે માનવી નહીં.

Poor acid distribution,અપૂરતું cooling અથવા ખોટી acid strengthથી SO3 absorption ઘટે અને mist વધે છે. Circulation, packing, cooler performance તથા mist elimination જાળવવાં. SO2/SO3 emissions monitor કરવા અને unsafe water entry રોકવી. DCDA વધુ conversionથી residual SO2 ઘટાડે છે,પરંતુ monitoring તથા safe shutdownની જરૂરિયાત દૂર કરતું નથી.

body.en:
Purity, crystal formation and separation

Ca/Mg impurities cause scale and poor process performance; remove them before ammoniation. Carbonation temperature, CO2 distribution, ammonia strength and residence time affect NaHCO3 crystallisation. Very fine crystals filter poorly; insufficient washing carries chloride into product, whereas excessive washing dissolves valuable bicarbonate.

Recovery, energy and deposits

Ammonia leaks raise cost and pollution; control tower sealing, condensation and free/combined-ammonia recovery. Kiln and calciner require efficient fuel use and stable heat transfer. Carbonate/lime deposits block lines, heat exchangers and stills; provide suitable cleaning and solids management. CO2 recovery equipment must supply adequate pressure without excessive dust or water carry-over.

Waste and product handling

CaCl2-rich liquor, high-salinity water, sludge, soda-ash dust and combustion emissions need managed outlets. Saleable by-products require a real quality-compliant market, not an assumed zero-waste claim. Maintain product density, particle size and moisture for the specified light/dense soda-ash grade.

title.en: How to study a manufacturing answer

body.en: State the product and route,raw materials and reaction;draw the correctly labelled flowsheet;explain each stage in arrow order with recycle/by-products;finish with key controls and uses. Equipment in original supplied scans must be identified by their printed names;E-numbers refer only to new study redraws.
body.gu: Product/route,raw materials તથા reaction લખો;સાચી labelled flowsheet દોરો;arrow order મુજબ દરેક stage તથા recycle/by-products સમજાવો;છેલ્લે key controls/uses આપો. મૂળ scansના equipmentને તેમના printed namesથી ઓળખો;E numbers ફક્ત નવા study redraws માટે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Scope and classification of chemical industries.
q.gu: Chemical Industriesનું કાર્યક્ષેત્ર તથા વર્ગીકરણની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: A chemical industry converts raw materials into useful substances through chemical reactions supported by physical operations such as mixing, separation and heat transfer. Chemical process technology connects the chemistry with plant equipment, material recovery, product quality and safe waste handling.
a.gu: રાસાયણિક અભિક્રિયા તથા mixing, separation અને heat transfer જેવી ભૌતિક પ્રક્રિયાઓથી કાચા માલને ઉપયોગી પદાર્થોમાં ફેરવતો ઉદ્યોગ એટલે chemical industry. Chemical process technologyમાં chemistry સાથે plant equipment, material recovery, product quality તથા સુરક્ષિત waste treatmentનો અભ્યાસ થાય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Sulphuric acid—properties and uses.
q.gu: સલ્ફ્યુરિક ઍસિડ—ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગોની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: H2SO4 is a strong diprotic mineral acid; commercial concentrated acid is commonly about98% by mass.
a.gu: H2SO4 મજબૂત diprotic mineral acid છે; સામાન્ય commercial concentrated acid આશરે98 mass% હોય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Hydrochloric acid—properties and uses.
q.gu: હાઇડ્રોક્લોરિક ઍસિડ—ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગોની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Hydrochloric acid is the aqueous solution of hydrogen chloride, HCl; dry HCl itself is a gas.
a.gu: Hydrogen chloride, HClનું પાણીમાં દ્રાવણ એટલે hydrochloric acid; dry HCl પોતે gas છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Soda ash—properties and uses.
q.gu: સોડા ઍશ—ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગોની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Soda ash is anhydrous sodium carbonate, Na2CO3;washing soda is its decahydrate, Na2CO3·10H2O.
a.gu: Anhydrous sodium carbonate, Na2CO3 એટલે soda ash; washing soda તેનું decahydrate Na2CO3·10H2O છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Caustic soda—properties and uses.
q.gu: કોસ્ટિક સોડા—ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગોની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Caustic soda is sodium hydroxide, NaOH, a strong alkali supplied as solutions, flakes or pellets.
a.gu: Sodium hydroxide, NaOH એટલે caustic soda; આ strong alkali solutions, flakes અથવા pellets રૂપે મળે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Sulphuric acid—DCDA.

a.en: DCDA means double contact, double absorption:a sulphuric-acid process in which catalytic SO2 oxidation is interrupted by SO3 absorption and followed by further oxidation and a final absorption.
a.gu: DCDA એટલે double contact, double absorption. તેમાં catalytic SO2 oxidationના બે conversion groups વચ્ચે SO3 શોષાય છે; ત્યારબાદ વધુ oxidation અને final absorption થાય છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Hydrochloric acid.

a.en: Hydrogen chloride is made by direct combination of hydrogen and chlorine; absorption of the resulting gas in water produces hydrochloric acid.
a.gu: Hydrogen અને chlorineના direct combinationથી hydrogen chloride gas બને છે; તેને પાણીમાં absorb કરવાથી hydrochloric acid મળે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Soda ash—Solvay process.

a.en: The Solvay process manufactures soda ash by precipitating sodium bicarbonate from ammoniated brine and calcining it; ammonia is regenerated from the mother liquor.
a.gu: Ammoniated brineમાંથી sodium bicarbonate precipitate કરીને તેને calcine કરી soda ash બનાવવાની અને mother liquorમાંથી ammonia પાછું મેળવવાની પદ્ધતિ એટલે Solvay process.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Caustic soda—electrolytic process.

a.en: Electrolytic chlor-alkali manufacture decomposes purified brine into chlorine, hydrogen and sodium hydroxide; the selected modern route uses an ion-selective membrane.
a.gu: Purified brineના electrolysisથી chlorine, hydrogen તથા sodium hydroxide બનાવવાનું chlor-alkali manufacture છે; અહીં modern ion-selective membrane route પસંદ છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Electrolytic caustic—working of the supplied diaphragm/mercury PDF.
q.gu: Electrolytic Caustic—મૂળ PDFની Diaphragm/Mercury Workingની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: The supplied page3contains two alternative historical routes, not two cells in series. Both use the overall chlor-alkali reaction, but their cathode products and purification requirements differ. The mercury route is retained for understanding the supplied drawing, not recommended as a new environmentally preferable installation.
a.gu: પાના3માં બે historical alternative routes છે; બે cells seriesમાં નથી. Overall chlor-alkali reaction સમાન છે,પરંતુ cathode products તથા purification જુદાં પડે છે. Mercury route ફક્ત મૂળ drawing સમજવા માટે રાખી છે; તેને નવા environmentally preferable plant તરીકે સૂચવેલ નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Major engineering problems—sulphuric acid manufacture.
q.gu: સલ્ફ્યુરિક ઍસિડ ઉત્પાદનની મુખ્ય Engineering સમસ્યાઓની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Dust and feed impurities can block passages or poison the vanadium catalyst. Provide sulphur filtration, air drying and appropriate gas cleaning. Excessive pressure drop reduces throughput; temperature profiling helps identify poor flow distribution or catalyst deterioration. Conversion requires both suitable catalytic rate and favourable equilibrium, so simply heating every bed more is not a solution.
a.gu: Dust તથા feed impurities passages block કરી શકે અથવા vanadium catalystને poison કરી શકે છે. Sulphur filtration, air drying તથા યોગ્ય gas cleaning રાખવાં. Excess pressure dropથી throughput ઘટે છે; temperature profilingથી poor distribution/catalyst deterioration શોધાય છે. Conversion માટે catalytic rate અને equilibrium બંને જોઈએ; દરેક bed વધારે ગરમ કરવો ઉપાય નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Major engineering problems—soda ash manufacture.
q.gu: સોડા ઍશ ઉત્પાદનની મુખ્ય Engineering સમસ્યાઓની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Ca/Mg impurities cause scale and poor process performance; remove them before ammoniation. Carbonation temperature, CO2 distribution, ammonia strength and residence time affect NaHCO3 crystallisation. Very fine crystals filter poorly; insufficient washing carries chloride into product, whereas excessive washing dissolves valuable bicarbonate.
a.gu: Ca/Mg impurities scale તથા poor performance કરે છે; ammoniation પહેલાં દૂર કરવાં. Carbonation temperature, CO2 distribution, ammonia strength તથા residence time, NaHCO3 crystallisationને અસર કરે છે. ખૂબ fine crystalsનું filtration મુશ્કેલ છે; ઓછું washing productમાં chloride લાવે છે અને અતિશય washing bicarbonate dissolve કરે છે.
